notes.title: [Tricks, Treats and Mirrors - An EoG Side Story] Store Page is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759378/ce5aa23c378da42e70423cb4802cf0e8c9903a3a.png[/img]

[i]Tricks, Treats and Mirrors and Mirrors - An EoG Side Story[/i] is our latest game! If you liked Synthetic Fantasy; or are curious for something spookier, check it out! Here's the trailer for it:

[previewyoutube=P7h10uiWzQM;full][/previewyoutube]

In [i]Synthetic Fantasy;[/i], you meet characters from [i]Echoes of G[/i]* acting in a play. In this new title, you will meet some of these characters as themselves, on Halloween night!

This new game will feature multiple different endings in a spooky haunted house setting! Navigate a secluded home on Halloween night to find your friend, who wandered inside for free candy. Your choices will determine whether or not you will survive to the end!

[b]Releasing this October, 2025![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451930/Tricks_Treats_and_Mirrors__An_EoG_Side_Story/]Visit the store page and give it a wishlist here![/url]

*[i]Echoes of G is a visual novel that we are currently planning. Visit the [url=https://echoesofg.com/]website[/url] to learn more.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes: Option to manipulate "Skip" settings has been removed.

notes.title: New Ending, Achievement and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759378/6005534156598817c06a782a87c9b901febbfbb2.png[/img]

This is quite the big update (relatively speaking, of course)! Maybe not much for those who have completed the game already, but who's complaining about some free content? Not me!

Here's what has been updated in the latest patch:

[list]
[*]A new ending, featuring Anima, has been added. Players may access this ending in Act 3.
[*]A new achievement tied to this ending has also been added.
[*]Dialogue tones have been added. They sound like beeps. The volume can be adjusted with the "Sound" slider in the Preferences menu.
[/list]

[h3][b]I would like to take this opportunity to ask for feedback on this game! Positive or negative, every bit helps! Take a minute to leave a review if you have the time![/b][/h3]

And that's all for now! We've got exciting new projects in the pipeline, so stay tuned by following our [url=https://x.com/LoneRabbitGames]Twitter/X page![/url]

Happy New Year,
-Lonely Rabbit Games

notes.title: Achievement Bugfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug regarding the "Synthetic Love" achievement not being granted upon reaching VALA's ending.

If Steam has not granted you the "Synthetic Love" achievement despite viewing VALA's ending, then you can now receive it by viewing that ending again.

I apologize for the inconvenience.
-Lonely Rabbit Games

notes.title: Price Change + New Project Coming to Steam
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As this is the first project we have released as an unknown name, it has become clear that charging for it has become counterproductive.

I'll cut to the chase. The game will be changing from its current price to [b]free[/b].

I'd like more people to be able to play our games so that we can grow. The best way to do this from our current position is to show people what we can do, as much as we can. 

To the people who have bought the game, you have my humblest gratitude. The game will remain on your accounts as-is, and if you fit in to Valve's refund criteria, file a support ticket so that they may assist you.

The planned date for this price change is around October 30th, 2024.

With all that being said, I'd like to also formally announce our next project coming to Steam: 

[b][i]Tricks, Treats and Mirrors - An EoG Side Story[/i][/b]!

This project was actually created for a Halloween-themed VN Jam, and is actually [url=https://lonelyrabbitgames.itch.io/tricks-treats-and-mirrors]already available on itch[/url]. There is no page available for it yet, but stay tuned- it's coming. That game will also be available for free here, as it is on itch. For more day-to-day updates regarding this and other projects, you may follow our page on Twitter/X (@LoneRabbitGames).

I look forward to creating more stories that people may enjoy.

Have fun,
-Lonely Rabbit Games
